ctx.x: He came in. And then the girl singer was Ida James: Ida was with Earl. There was another girl singer. I can't -- Madeline Green. I don't know if you remember her. She was with him too. But Budd Johnson was on that band. Ray Nance was on. In fact, Ray Nance was the guy who encouraged me to go with Lunceford. I wasn't going to go because I was having too much fun with Earl.

Earl's band was loose, you know, like no restrictions but Lunceford was -- you know, like you have to do this exactly like that. And, you know, when you're young you don't like -- you don't go for that too much, you know. And everything was just -- had to be just so and so.
